title: Walking Venetian Candia
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Locate eight landmarks of Venetian and Ottoman Heraklion on an unlabeled street map of the old town, then see the route of our Day 9 walk.

learningObjectives: Locate eight landmarks of Venetian and Ottoman Heraklion on a street map of the old town, placing at least six of the eight within 150 m of the true position on the first attempt.

dependencies: Esri World Light Gray Base tiles

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Retrieval practice: locate on a map, then reveal
keyQuestions: Where does Koules Fortress stand relative to the town's shore?
On which side of the town do the Venetian walls run?
How far apart are the fountain, the Loggia, and Agios Titos?
commonMisconceptions: The Koules stands on the shore of the town rather than out at the end of the harbor breakwater.
The Venetian walls run along the harbor, when they enclose the town on its landward side.
The landmarks are spread across the city, when the Venetian civic center lies within about 200 m.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score on eight cards (mastery: 6 of 8 within 150 m).
Describe the walk from the Lions to the Koules: direction and distance.
